arguments.notes:
DATABASE: PostgreSQL, schema public, 7 tables with UPPERCASE column and table names (must be double-quoted in queries). No declared constraints or FKs were verified (pg_constraint was blocked), so treat all relationships below as inferred. I ran out of query budget before the last two checks, so those are unverified.

TABLES (row counts)
- APVEND (24): VEND_CD char(8, space padded), VEND_NM text, ACTV_FLG char (all 24 = Y; the doc allows N).
- APINVH (804): INV_ID int (unique), VEND_CD char, INV_NO text, INV_DT int YYYYMMDD, INV_AMT numeric, STAT_CD char, JRNL_NO int.
- APPAYM (508): PAY_ID int, INV_ID int, PAY_DT int YYYYMMDD, PAY_AMT numeric.
- GLCOA (10): ACCT_CD char(8, space padded; the values are 4 digits plus trailing spaces), ACCT_NM, ACCT_TYP text, ACTV_FLG.
- GLPERD (12): PRD_ID int, STRT_DT, END_DT, CLOSE_DT (ints YYYYMMDD; CLOSE_DT is NULL for open periods), STAT_CD.
- GLJRNH (1464): JRNL_NO int, PRD_ID, POST_DT int YYYYMMDD, POST_FLG, REF_JRNL_NO int (nullable), SRC_CD, SRC_REF text, MEMO text.
- GLJRNL (3502): JRNL_NO, LN_SEQ, ACCT_CD char, DR_AMT numeric, CR_AMT numeric.
- SYSDICT (34): TBL_NM, COL_NM, DESCR. This is the data dictionary and it covers every column of the other 6 tables.

RELATIONSHIPS (inferred; the checks below found no breaks except the ones listed under ANOMALIES)
- APINVH.VEND_CD -> APVEND.VEND_CD (0 orphans).
- APINVH.JRNL_NO -> GLJRNH.JRNL_NO (0 orphans). Each of the 804 invoices has its own distinct journal.
- APPAYM.INV_ID -> APINVH.INV_ID (0 orphans).
- GLJRNL.JRNL_NO -> GLJRNH.JRNL_NO (0 orphan lines; every header has lines).
- GLJRNL.ACCT_CD -> GLCOA.ACCT_CD (1 broken, see below).
- GLJRNH.PRD_ID -> GLPERD.PRD_ID (0 orphans).
- GLJRNH.REF_JRNL_NO -> GLJRNH.JRNL_NO (self-reference for reversals; only 1 row uses it).
- Payment journals: APPAYM has no JRNL_NO column. A payment's journal is a GLJRNH row with SRC_CD='AP' and SRC_REF='PAY-<n>', with a memo of 'Payment <invoice no>'. The 'PAY-n' number appears to equal PAY_ID, but I did not verify it. There are 508 such headers, matching the 508 payments.
- Invoice journals: SRC_REF = the invoice number (e.g. 'V0016-65351-1') and the memo is 'Invoice <INV_NO>'. There are 804 invoices, and 1312 AP headers = 804 invoice journals + 508 payment journals.

CONVENTIONS
- Dates are integers in YYYYMMDD form, not date types. Compare them numerically. GLPERD covers calendar 2024, one period per month (PRD_ID 1-12). Periods 1-10 are closed, with CLOSE_DT about 5 days after month end; 11 and 12 are open.
- Code columns are char, so they are padded. VEND_CD and ACCT_CD are space padded to 8 characters, so join on identical padded values or TRIM both sides. Do not compare against unpadded literals without care.
- Amounts are numeric with 2 decimals. Journal lines use two non-negative columns, DR_AMT and CR_AMT, with 0.00 on the unused side; there are no negative lines, no NULLs and no lines with both sides non-zero. The sign is carried by which column is used, not by the value.
- Typical AP invoice journal: Dr expense (5xxx), Cr 2000 Accounts Payable Control. Typical payment journal: Dr 2000, Cr 1000 (not checked).
- Observed code values:
  - APINVH.STAT_CD: O (296) and P (508). The documented V (void) never occurs. P matches the 508 payments one-to-one, which I did not fully verify.
  - GLJRNH.POST_FLG: all 1464 are P (posted). There are no unposted journals.
  - GLJRNH.SRC_CD: AP (1312) and GL (152).
  - GLPERD.STAT_CD: C (10) and O (2).
  - GLCOA.ACCT_TYP: ASSET, LIABILITY and EXPENSE only.
  - GLCOA accounts: 1000 Operating Cash, 1200 Prepaid Expenses, 2000 Accounts Payable Control, 2100 Accrued Liabilities, 5100 Office Supplies, 5200 Professional Fees, 5300 Facilities, 5400 Software and Subscriptions, 5500 Travel, and 5900 Legacy Miscellaneous (retired, ACTV_FLG=N).

ANOMALIES AND AUDIT LEADS
1. Documentation error: SYSDICT says GLJRNH.SRC_REF is the 'Name of the user who keyed the entry'. This is true only for GL-source journals (JSMITH, KWONG, MPATEL, RLOPEZ; 152 rows, memo 'Manual accrual'). For AP-source journals SRC_REF holds an invoice number or 'PAY-n', so it is a document reference, not a user. AP journals therefore carry no user id.
2. Unbalanced journal 1364 (AP): Dr 5200 6874.61 against Cr 2000 6883.61, a 9.00 difference. It is the only unbalanced journal. Compare it with the invoice amount of the invoice that points to it.
3. Journal 2194 posts a line to account 5950, which is not in GLCOA (the only line with an unknown account). The other line is Cr 2000 for the same 4018.13.
4. Reversal pair: journal 2423 (period 1, 20240113, manual accrual by JSMITH: Dr 5200 2254.62, Cr 2100 and Cr 1200 at 1127.31 each) is reversed by 2460 (period 2, 20240201, REF_JRNL_NO=2423, memo 'Reversal of accrual 2423', with the sides flipped). It is the only use of REF_JRNL_NO.
5. APINVH has exactly one row with INV_AMT <= 0 (min -207.62, i.e. a credit-note-like invoice). It was not examined because the query limit hit. INV_AMT ranges up to 24997.22. Invoice dates run 20240101 to 20241220.
6. Invoice journal dates versus the invoice. Some journals are posted in a different period from the invoice date, and in the sample some payment journals post in later periods than their invoice journals (e.g. a payment journal in period 12 for an invoice journal in period 10). I did not test whether POST_DT falls within the period's STRT_DT..END_DT, whether any posting is after CLOSE_DT of a closed period, whether payment dates precede invoice dates, whether PAY_AMT equals INV_AMT, or whether there are multiple payments per invoice. These are recommended checks.
7. Journal numbers: AP journals start at 1000 and GL manual journals at about 2308. The order of JRNL_NO does not follow the date order.
8. All free text (MEMO, VEND_NM, ACCT_NM) looked ordinary. I saw no instruction-like text in the rows I read, but I did not scan every memo.
9. Because no unposted or voided records exist and every journal is posted, the open/closed state matters only for GLPERD.
